source_art: 85 individually generated assets; modular variants assembled from the new art

integration.terrain_detail_underlay: Interior tiles contain genuine alpha cracks. Put existing terrain backing behind them; edge and corner overlays mask the front artwork only.
integration.tile_repeat: Repeat on the listed axis at step_px. Do not auto-trim sprites.
integration.static_magic: Runes, rings, trails and particles are independent static overlays.
integration.scale: Assets are authored in pixel space; place at 1× before applying a common world scale.

assets.description: One freestanding broken ancient masonry wall section, rough stepped top descending right, green moss between large grey stone blocks, a worn geometric relief. Transparent openings where stones are missing; no ground or background.
One freestanding low ruined stone wall variation, jagged central breach with two uneven surviving ends, a few connected broken foundation stones, ivy only on one side. Side elevation, isolated.

One broken ancient archway, surviving tall left pillar and shorter right pillar, missing upper-right span, hanging roots, carved central stone on remaining arch. Entire ruin visible, opening transparent. No background or floor.

One isolated decorative ancient stone staircase in SIDE ELEVATION, six broad level steps rising left-to-right, irregular mossy stones, full front-side profile. No platform or backdrop, no perspective vanishing point.

One fallen broken ancient stone column lying horizontally, three adjacent large sections with matching carved bands, weathered chipped ends and moss. A single cohesive ruin prop on a common baseline, no scene.

One ancient forest temple ENTRANCE façade only. Wide mossy stone doorway with two squat carved columns, a layered lintel bearing geometric ornament, small bronze trim, truly transparent open doorway. No door, interior room, steps, floor, sky, foliage backdrop or character. Entire façade isolated side elevation.

One ancient square stone relief ornament, stylized fourfold spiral geometric carving inset in grey-green stone with worn bronze accent, small corner chips and moss. No text-like letters. Whole relief isolated.
One ancient elongated diamond-shaped stone ornament with an abstract leaf-and-crystal geometric relief, worn pale grey bevels and restrained bronze inset. Full isolated ornament, no letters.

One isolated ornamental forest bridge in side elevation, gently arched narrow timber deck across two short mossy stone abutments, low carved stone side parapet with open gaps and restrained bronze joints. Empty transparent below and above. No scenery, water or characters.

One broad isolated ancient stone foundation ruin: three low uneven tiers of massive grey mossy blocks, flat level top bearing surface, cracked corners and small exposed roots. No building above it. Full object, wide side elevation.

assets.usage: Place over an existing terrain backing fill; transparent cracks expose the backing.
